items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: Von Gammon then became leader and they had... I just don't remember what they used to charge them. And this is the way that I practically learned all of the Dixieland tunes, right, right in that Fern dance hall.

ctx.x: Right. Did all this extracurricular activity bump into your schooling and did you have to quit

or did you carry on? Well, that's right. I gave up. I was going to Warren Eastern High School at the time and found out that I couldn't quite make it. So I said, well, I knew right then and there, I said, there's only one thing for me, that's music. I had no desire to learn anything else but just to play music. Now you asked me about some musicians. Here was a place where I began meeting the old Real Dixieland musicians.
